item.title: aMQTT: Denial of Service (DoS) via Memory Leak in Unmanaged QoS 2 Session Handshakes
item.description: Impact amqtt is vulnerable to a remote denial of service caused by incomplete MQTT QoS 2 transactions remaining allocated after the associated client disconnects. MQTT QoS 2 uses a four-step handshake to provide exactly-once delivery. If a client begins a QoS 2 transaction but disconnects before the handshake completes, amqtt retains the associated transaction state and packet identifier without an expiration…
